provenance: Offsets compensate Konnect issue #667: CPL Mid X/Mid Y carries the KiCad footprint ANCHOR rather than the component midpoint, so any footprint whose anchor is not centred lands off by the anchor-to-centre vector. IMPORTANT: these offsets are applied in BOARD axes (x_after = x + offset_x, y_after = y - offset_y), so a footprint-local anchor-to-centre vector must be rotated by the placement angle before being written here. Values below are the measured board-space anchor-to-pad-bbox-centre vectors: HDR1 (180 deg) +7.62, HDR2 (0 deg) -7.62, J2 (90 deg) +3.0 on Y — J2's vector is +3.0mm in footprint-local X, which its 90 deg placement maps onto board Y. J1, R1-R4 and C1 need no offset; their anchors already sit at their pad-bbox centres. SW1 is hand-soldered and excluded from the position file. Verified by the project owner in JLCPCB Component Placements on 2026-09-21: HDR1/HDR2 render correctly at +90 (carried over from garage-console, same footprint); J2 rendered displaced along +X, which identified the axis error corrected in v2; J1 rendered turned 90 deg from its pad row, corrected here with +270 so the CPL reads 0 deg. RE-CHECK THE PREVIEW after this revision: if J1 now sits along the right axis but with pin 1 at the wrong end, change its rotation_degrees from 270 to 90 (CPL 180 deg). REMOVE the offsets if Konnect starts exporting true midpoints.
